profile.name: Eurobank S.A.
profile.summary: Eurobank S.A. provides retail, corporate and private banking, asset management, treasury and capital market, and other services in Greece, Bulgaria, Cyprus, and Luxembourg. It operates through Retail, Corporate, Markets, International, and Investment Property. The company offers current accounts, savings, deposits and investment savings products, credit and debit cards, consumer loans, small business banking, and mortgages, as well as overdrafts, loans and other credit facilities, foreign currency, and derivative products. It also provides custody and clearing services, cash management and trade service, and investment banking services, including corporate finance, and merger and acquisitions advice services. In addition, the company offers financial instruments trading and services to institutional investors, as well as specialized financial advice and intermediation services; and mutual fund products, institutional asset management, and equity brokerage services. Further, it is involved in investment property activities related to a portfolio of commercial real estate assets. Additionally, the company engages in the provision of business-to-business e-commerce, accounting, tax, sundry, leasing, factoring, investment banking, asset management, brokerage, informatics data processing services; real estate business and real estate services; fund management; insurance agency and brokerage services; general and life insurance; pension assurance intermediary business; and production and distribution of solar generated electric energy. Eurobank S.A. was founded in 1924 and is based in Athens, Greece. Eurobank S.A. was formerly a subsidiary of Eurobank Ergasias Services and Holdings S.A.
profile.summary_fr: Eurobank S.A. fournit des services de banque de détail, de banque d'affaires et de banque privée, de gestion d'actifs, de trésorerie et de marché des capitaux, ainsi que d'autres services en Grèce, en Bulgarie, à Chypre et au Luxembourg. Il opère à travers le commerce de détail, les entreprises, les marchés, l'international et l'investissement immobilier. La société offre des comptes courants, de l'épargne, des dépôts et des produits d'épargne de placement, des cartes de crédit et de débit, des prêts à la consommation, des services bancaires aux petites entreprises et des prêts hypothécaires, ainsi que des découverts, des prêts et d'autres facilités de crédit, des devises étrangères et des produits dérivés.
